zh.param.frame_nums.label: 抽帧数量
zh.param.frame_nums.desc: 控制每轮使用的关键帧数量，数值越高覆盖更充分但耗时更长。
zh.param.crop_quantile.label: 裁剪置信分位
zh.param.crop_quantile.desc: 用于过滤画面边缘和离群区域，越高越保守地保留主体。
zh.param.iterations.label: 训练迭代次数
zh.param.iterations.desc: 决定高斯点优化轮数，数值越大通常更细致但等待更久。
zh.param.radius.label: 融合半径
zh.param.radius.desc: 控制网格融合时的空间范围，半径越大越容易连成整体。
zh.param.cluster_voxel_size.label: 聚类体素尺寸
zh.param.cluster_voxel_size.desc: 用于清理碎片簇，数值越大越倾向合并小结构。
zh.param.keep_largest.label: 仅保留最大连通块
zh.param.keep_largest.desc: 开启后会删除较小漂浮碎片，让主体网格更干净。
zh.param.iteration.label: 网格优化迭代
zh.param.iteration.desc: 控制 Mesh 阶段的优化次数，增加后通常更平滑但更慢。
zh.param.views.label: 参与视角
zh.param.views.desc: 选择参与融合的视角集合，默认使用训练视角。
zh.param.voxel_size.label: TSDF 体素尺寸
zh.param.voxel_size.desc: 决定网格重建的空间精度，越小细节越多但显存压力更高。
zh.param.sdf_trunc.label: SDF 截断距离
zh.param.sdf_trunc.desc: 限制深度融合的有效距离，影响表面厚度和空洞修补。
zh.param.alpha_threshold.label: 透明度阈值
zh.param.alpha_threshold.desc: 过滤透明或低置信区域，阈值越高网格越干净但可能缺细节。
zh.param.max_depth.label: 最大深度
zh.param.max_depth.desc: 限制可参与融合的最远深度，避免远处背景干扰主体。
zh.param.depth_quantile.label: 深度分位过滤
zh.param.depth_quantile.desc: 按深度置信度裁掉离群值，数值越高保留范围越宽。
zh.param.mask_erode.label: 遮罩腐蚀强度
zh.param.mask_erode.desc: 收缩前景遮罩边缘，减少边缘毛刺和背景粘连。

en.param.frame_nums.label: Frame samples
en.param.frame_nums.desc: Controls how many key frames are used per pass; higher values improve coverage but take longer.
en.param.crop_quantile.label: Crop quantile
en.param.crop_quantile.desc: Filters edges and outliers; higher values keep the subject more conservatively.
en.param.iterations.label: Training iterations
en.param.iterations.desc: Controls Gaussian optimization rounds; higher values are usually finer but slower.
en.param.radius.label: Fusion radius
en.param.radius.desc: Controls the spatial range for mesh fusion; larger radii connect regions more easily.
en.param.cluster_voxel_size.label: Cluster voxel size
en.param.cluster_voxel_size.desc: Cleans small clusters; larger values tend to merge small structures.
en.param.keep_largest.label: Keep largest component
en.param.keep_largest.desc: Removes smaller floating fragments to keep the main mesh cleaner.
en.param.iteration.label: Mesh optimization iterations
en.param.iteration.desc: Controls mesh-stage optimization; more iterations are smoother but slower.
en.param.views.label: View set
en.param.views.desc: Chooses the view set used for fusion; train views are used by default.
en.param.voxel_size.label: TSDF voxel size
en.param.voxel_size.desc: Controls spatial precision; smaller values keep more detail but cost more memory.
en.param.sdf_trunc.label: SDF truncation
en.param.sdf_trunc.desc: Limits the effective distance for depth fusion, affecting thickness and hole filling.
en.param.alpha_threshold.label: Alpha threshold
en.param.alpha_threshold.desc: Filters transparent or low-confidence regions; higher values are cleaner but may lose detail.
en.param.max_depth.label: Maximum depth
en.param.max_depth.desc: Limits the farthest depth used for fusion to reduce background interference.
en.param.depth_quantile.label: Depth quantile filter
en.param.depth_quantile.desc: Cuts depth outliers by confidence; higher values keep a wider range.
en.param.mask_erode.label: Mask erosion
en.param.mask_erode.desc: Shrinks foreground mask edges to reduce edge noise and background sticking.
